title: Customer Support Executive
description: We're looking for enthusiastic Customer Support Executives to join our growing BPO team. You'll be the first point of contact for our clients' customers, handling inquiries, resolving issues, and ensuring exceptional service.
responsibilities: Handle inbound and outbound customer calls professionally
Resolve customer queries and complaints within defined SLA
Maintain accurate records of all interactions in CRM
Meet daily/monthly performance targets (calls, resolution rate, CSAT)
Escalate complex issues to senior team members as needed
Follow call scripts while maintaining a natural, empathetic tone
requirements: Minimum 10+2 or Graduate degree
Excellent verbal communication in Hindi and English
Basic computer literacy (MS Office, typing speed 25+ WPM)
Ability to work in rotational shifts
Customer-first mindset with problem-solving attitude
Prior BPO/call center experience preferred but not mandatory
benefits: PF and ESI as per government norms

title: Senior Web Developer
description: Join our technology team as a Senior Web Developer to build responsive, high-performance websites and web applications for our diverse client portfolio. You'll lead development projects from design handoff to deployment.
responsibilities: Develop responsive websites and web applications using modern technologies
Collaborate with designers to implement pixel-perfect UI
Optimize applications for speed, SEO, and performance
Mentor junior developers and conduct code reviews
Integrate third-party APIs and payment gateways
Maintain and upgrade existing client websites
Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code
requirements: 3-5 years of professional web development experience
Proficiency in React.js / Next.js
Strong knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript
Experience with Node.js and REST APIs
Familiarity with version control (Git)
Understanding of SEO best practices
Experience with databases (MySQL, MongoDB)
Good communication and problem-solving skills
benefits: Hybrid work model (3 days office, 2 days remote)
Opportunity to work on diverse projects

title: Team Leader – BPO
description: We're seeking an experienced Team Leader to manage and motivate a team of Customer Support Executives, ensuring service quality, meeting targets, and driving continuous improvement.
responsibilities: Supervise and mentor a team of 15-20 Customer Support Executives
Monitor team performance metrics and ensure SLA adherence
Conduct daily team briefings and performance feedback sessions
Handle escalated customer complaints and complex cases
Prepare daily/weekly performance reports for management
Identify training needs and coordinate with the training team
Drive team engagement and maintain low attrition
requirements: 2-4 years of BPO experience with at least 1 year in a supervisory role
Excellent leadership and people management skills
Strong analytical skills with ability to interpret metrics
Proficiency in MS Excel and reporting tools
Excellent Hindi and English communication
Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines
Prior experience in financial services or auto industry BPO preferred
